name: cross_zone_spread_hourly
description: Hourly EUR price spread between neighbouring zones (spread = zone_a - zone_b), only for hours where both zones have a price.

columns.name: price_eur_a
columns.description: Hourly mean price of zone_a in EUR/MWh.

columns.name: price_eur_b
columns.description: Hourly mean price of zone_b in EUR/MWh.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Calendar year of the UTC timestamp (partition column).
